name: Google Drive
description: Typed Google Drive files, sharing, shared drives, changes, revisions, comments and bounded byte transfers.

permissions.description: Explicit HTTPS Google Drive v3 requests; encrypted supplied OAuth token or selected connection credentials. Confirmed operations can create, share, alter and permanently delete resources. Alternative secrets require host authorization. No filesystem, token refresh, retries or listeners.

definitions.name: List Files (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
List Files: GET /files. Exactly one request, no retries, redirects or automatic pagination. OAuth bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; optional built-in $connection profile uses RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken, apiKey or password as an already issued bearer token. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. Supply OAuth scopes and provider permissions appropriate to this operation; issuance, refresh and service-account signing are external. Fixed www.googleapis.com. Strict request fields, resource IDs, UTF-16/UTF-8; 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline starts before profile/secret resolution, 1 MiB JSON response, 256 KiB binary transfers, 512 KiB request and 100 ms bounded cleanup. Pages 1–100, explicit pageToken continuation. Known provider fields projected to typed resources; unknown fields omitted. Size/version/quota strings preserve integer precision. Files update addParents/removeParents perform explicit moves. Native Workspace files require Export; Download uses alt=media for stored binary files. New byte upload is one multipart request; replacement uses simple media. No resumable sessions, emptyTrash, watchers, automatic ownership transfer or background listeners. Sharing/ownership changes require suitable query and permission fields and must run sequentially per file. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3 https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/files https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-uploads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-downloads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-sharing https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/changes/list https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2

definitions.name: Get File Metadata (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Get File Metadata: GET /files/{fileId}. Exactly one request, no retries, redirects or automatic pagination. OAuth bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; optional built-in $connection profile uses RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken, apiKey or password as an already issued bearer token. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. Supply OAuth scopes and provider permissions appropriate to this operation; issuance, refresh and service-account signing are external. Fixed www.googleapis.com. Strict request fields, resource IDs, UTF-16/UTF-8; 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline starts before profile/secret resolution, 1 MiB JSON response, 256 KiB binary transfers, 512 KiB request and 100 ms bounded cleanup. Pages 1–100, explicit pageToken continuation. Known provider fields projected to typed resources; unknown fields omitted. Size/version/quota strings preserve integer precision. Files update addParents/removeParents perform explicit moves. Native Workspace files require Export; Download uses alt=media for stored binary files. New byte upload is one multipart request; replacement uses simple media. No resumable sessions, emptyTrash, watchers, automatic ownership transfer or background listeners. Sharing/ownership changes require suitable query and permission fields and must run sequentially per file. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3 https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/files https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-uploads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-downloads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-sharing https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/changes/list https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Create File Metadata (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Create File Metadata: POST /files. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation FILES_CREATE. External action may succeed before a timeout; reconcile before repeating. Exactly one request, no retries, redirects or automatic pagination. OAuth bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; optional built-in $connection profile uses RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken, apiKey or password as an already issued bearer token. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. Supply OAuth scopes and provider permissions appropriate to this operation; issuance, refresh and service-account signing are external. Fixed www.googleapis.com. Strict request fields, resource IDs, UTF-16/UTF-8; 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline starts before profile/secret resolution, 1 MiB JSON response, 256 KiB binary transfers, 512 KiB request and 100 ms bounded cleanup. Pages 1–100, explicit pageToken continuation. Known provider fields projected to typed resources; unknown fields omitted. Size/version/quota strings preserve integer precision. Files update addParents/removeParents perform explicit moves. Native Workspace files require Export; Download uses alt=media for stored binary files. New byte upload is one multipart request; replacement uses simple media. No resumable sessions, emptyTrash, watchers, automatic ownership transfer or background listeners. Sharing/ownership changes require suitable query and permission fields and must run sequentially per file. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3 https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/files https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-uploads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-downloads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-sharing https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/changes/list https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2

definitions.name: Update File Metadata or Parents (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Update File Metadata or Parents: PATCH /files/{fileId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation FILES_UPDATE. External action may succeed before a timeout; reconcile before repeating. Exactly one request, no retries, redirects or automatic pagination. OAuth bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; optional built-in $connection profile uses RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken, apiKey or password as an already issued bearer token. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. Supply OAuth scopes and provider permissions appropriate to this operation; issuance, refresh and service-account signing are external. Fixed www.googleapis.com. Strict request fields, resource IDs, UTF-16/UTF-8; 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline starts before profile/secret resolution, 1 MiB JSON response, 256 KiB binary transfers, 512 KiB request and 100 ms bounded cleanup. Pages 1–100, explicit pageToken continuation. Known provider fields projected to typed resources; unknown fields omitted. Size/version/quota strings preserve integer precision. Files update addParents/removeParents perform explicit moves. Native Workspace files require Export; Download uses alt=media for stored binary files. New byte upload is one multipart request; replacement uses simple media. No resumable sessions, emptyTrash, watchers, automatic ownership transfer or background listeners. Sharing/ownership changes require suitable query and permission fields and must run sequentially per file. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3 https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/files https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-uploads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-downloads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-sharing https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/changes/list https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2

definitions.name: Copy File (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Copy File: POST /files/{fileId}/copy. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation FILES_COPY. External action may succeed before a timeout; reconcile before repeating. Exactly one request, no retries, redirects or automatic pagination. OAuth bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; optional built-in $connection profile uses RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken, apiKey or password as an already issued bearer token. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. Supply OAuth scopes and provider permissions appropriate to this operation; issuance, refresh and service-account signing are external. Fixed www.googleapis.com. Strict request fields, resource IDs, UTF-16/UTF-8; 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline starts before profile/secret resolution, 1 MiB JSON response, 256 KiB binary transfers, 512 KiB request and 100 ms bounded cleanup. Pages 1–100, explicit pageToken continuation. Known provider fields projected to typed resources; unknown fields omitted. Size/version/quota strings preserve integer precision. Files update addParents/removeParents perform explicit moves. Native Workspace files require Export; Download uses alt=media for stored binary files. New byte upload is one multipart request; replacement uses simple media. No resumable sessions, emptyTrash, watchers, automatic ownership transfer or background listeners. Sharing/ownership changes require suitable query and permission fields and must run sequentially per file. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3 https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/files https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-uploads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-downloads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-sharing https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/changes/list https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2

definitions.documentation:
Permanently Delete File: DELETE /files/{fileId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation FILES_DELETE. External action may succeed before a timeout; reconcile before repeating. Exactly one request, no retries, redirects or automatic pagination. OAuth bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; optional built-in $connection profile uses RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken, apiKey or password as an already issued bearer token. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. Supply OAuth scopes and provider permissions appropriate to this operation; issuance, refresh and service-account signing are external. Fixed www.googleapis.com. Strict request fields, resource IDs, UTF-16/UTF-8; 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline starts before profile/secret resolution, 1 MiB JSON response, 256 KiB binary transfers, 512 KiB request and 100 ms bounded cleanup. Pages 1–100, explicit pageToken continuation. Known provider fields projected to typed resources; unknown fields omitted. Size/version/quota strings preserve integer precision. Files update addParents/removeParents perform explicit moves. Native Workspace files require Export; Download uses alt=media for stored binary files. New byte upload is one multipart request; replacement uses simple media. No resumable sessions, emptyTrash, watchers, automatic ownership transfer or background listeners. Sharing/ownership changes require suitable query and permission fields and must run sequentially per file. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3 https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/files https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-uploads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-downloads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-sharing https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/changes/list https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2

definitions.name: Download File Bytes (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Download File Bytes: GET /files/{fileId}. Exactly one request, no retries, redirects or automatic pagination. OAuth bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; optional built-in $connection profile uses RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken, apiKey or password as an already issued bearer token. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. Supply OAuth scopes and provider permissions appropriate to this operation; issuance, refresh and service-account signing are external. Fixed www.googleapis.com. Strict request fields, resource IDs, UTF-16/UTF-8; 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline starts before profile/secret resolution, 1 MiB JSON response, 256 KiB binary transfers, 512 KiB request and 100 ms bounded cleanup. Pages 1–100, explicit pageToken continuation. Known provider fields projected to typed resources; unknown fields omitted. Size/version/quota strings preserve integer precision. Files update addParents/removeParents perform explicit moves. Native Workspace files require Export; Download uses alt=media for stored binary files. New byte upload is one multipart request; replacement uses simple media. No resumable sessions, emptyTrash, watchers, automatic ownership transfer or background listeners. Sharing/ownership changes require suitable query and permission fields and must run sequentially per file. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3 https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/files https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-uploads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-downloads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-sharing https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/changes/list https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2

definitions.name: Export Workspace File Bytes (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Export Workspace File Bytes: GET /files/{fileId}/export. Exactly one request, no retries, redirects or automatic pagination. OAuth bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; optional built-in $connection profile uses RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken, apiKey or password as an already issued bearer token. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. Supply OAuth scopes and provider permissions appropriate to this operation; issuance, refresh and service-account signing are external. Fixed www.googleapis.com. Strict request fields, resource IDs, UTF-16/UTF-8; 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline starts before profile/secret resolution, 1 MiB JSON response, 256 KiB binary transfers, 512 KiB request and 100 ms bounded cleanup. Pages 1–100, explicit pageToken continuation. Known provider fields projected to typed resources; unknown fields omitted. Size/version/quota strings preserve integer precision. Files update addParents/removeParents perform explicit moves. Native Workspace files require Export; Download uses alt=media for stored binary files. New byte upload is one multipart request; replacement uses simple media. No resumable sessions, emptyTrash, watchers, automatic ownership transfer or background listeners. Sharing/ownership changes require suitable query and permission fields and must run sequentially per file. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3 https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/files https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-uploads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-downloads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-sharing https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/changes/list https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2

definitions.name: Replace File Bytes (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Replace File Bytes: PATCH /files/{fileId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation FILES_REPLACE_CONTENT. External action may succeed before a timeout; reconcile before repeating. Exactly one request, no retries, redirects or automatic pagination. OAuth bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; optional built-in $connection profile uses RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken, apiKey or password as an already issued bearer token. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. Supply OAuth scopes and provider permissions appropriate to this operation; issuance, refresh and service-account signing are external. Fixed www.googleapis.com. Strict request fields, resource IDs, UTF-16/UTF-8; 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline starts before profile/secret resolution, 1 MiB JSON response, 256 KiB binary transfers, 512 KiB request and 100 ms bounded cleanup. Pages 1–100, explicit pageToken continuation. Known provider fields projected to typed resources; unknown fields omitted. Size/version/quota strings preserve integer precision. Files update addParents/removeParents perform explicit moves. Native Workspace files require Export; Download uses alt=media for stored binary files. New byte upload is one multipart request; replacement uses simple media. No resumable sessions, emptyTrash, watchers, automatic ownership transfer or background listeners. Sharing/ownership changes require suitable query and permission fields and must run sequentially per file. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3 https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/files https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-uploads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-downloads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-sharing https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/changes/list https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2

definitions.name: List File Permissions (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
List File Permissions: GET /files/{fileId}/permissions. Exactly one request, no retries, redirects or automatic pagination. OAuth bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; optional built-in $connection profile uses RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken, apiKey or password as an already issued bearer token. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. Supply OAuth scopes and provider permissions appropriate to this operation; issuance, refresh and service-account signing are external. Fixed www.googleapis.com. Strict request fields, resource IDs, UTF-16/UTF-8; 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline starts before profile/secret resolution, 1 MiB JSON response, 256 KiB binary transfers, 512 KiB request and 100 ms bounded cleanup. Pages 1–100, explicit pageToken continuation. Known provider fields projected to typed resources; unknown fields omitted. Size/version/quota strings preserve integer precision. Files update addParents/removeParents perform explicit moves. Native Workspace files require Export; Download uses alt=media for stored binary files. New byte upload is one multipart request; replacement uses simple media. No resumable sessions, emptyTrash, watchers, automatic ownership transfer or background listeners. Sharing/ownership changes require suitable query and permission fields and must run sequentially per file. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3 https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/files https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-uploads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-downloads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-sharing https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/changes/list https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2

definitions.name: Get File Permission (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Get File Permission: GET /files/{fileId}/permissions/{permissionId}. Exactly one request, no retries, redirects or automatic pagination. OAuth bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; optional built-in $connection profile uses RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken, apiKey or password as an already issued bearer token. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. Supply OAuth scopes and provider permissions appropriate to this operation; issuance, refresh and service-account signing are external. Fixed www.googleapis.com. Strict request fields, resource IDs, UTF-16/UTF-8; 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline starts before profile/secret resolution, 1 MiB JSON response, 256 KiB binary transfers, 512 KiB request and 100 ms bounded cleanup. Pages 1–100, explicit pageToken continuation. Known provider fields projected to typed resources; unknown fields omitted. Size/version/quota strings preserve integer precision. Files update addParents/removeParents perform explicit moves. Native Workspace files require Export; Download uses alt=media for stored binary files. New byte upload is one multipart request; replacement uses simple media. No resumable sessions, emptyTrash, watchers, automatic ownership transfer or background listeners. Sharing/ownership changes require suitable query and permission fields and must run sequentially per file. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3 https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/files https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-uploads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-downloads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-sharing https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/changes/list https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2

definitions.name: Create File Permission (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Create File Permission: POST /files/{fileId}/permissions. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation PERMISSIONS_CREATE. External action may succeed before a timeout; reconcile before repeating. Exactly one request, no retries, redirects or automatic pagination. OAuth bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; optional built-in $connection profile uses RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken, apiKey or password as an already issued bearer token. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. Supply OAuth scopes and provider permissions appropriate to this operation; issuance, refresh and service-account signing are external. Fixed www.googleapis.com. Strict request fields, resource IDs, UTF-16/UTF-8; 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline starts before profile/secret resolution, 1 MiB JSON response, 256 KiB binary transfers, 512 KiB request and 100 ms bounded cleanup. Pages 1–100, explicit pageToken continuation. Known provider fields projected to typed resources; unknown fields omitted. Size/version/quota strings preserve integer precision. Files update addParents/removeParents perform explicit moves. Native Workspace files require Export; Download uses alt=media for stored binary files. New byte upload is one multipart request; replacement uses simple media. No resumable sessions, emptyTrash, watchers, automatic ownership transfer or background listeners. Sharing/ownership changes require suitable query and permission fields and must run sequentially per file. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3 https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/files https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-uploads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-downloads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-sharing https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/changes/list https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2

definitions.documentation:
Update File Permission: PATCH /files/{fileId}/permissions/{permissionId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation PERMISSIONS_UPDATE. External action may succeed before a timeout; reconcile before repeating. Exactly one request, no retries, redirects or automatic pagination. OAuth bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; optional built-in $connection profile uses RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken, apiKey or password as an already issued bearer token. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. Supply OAuth scopes and provider permissions appropriate to this operation; issuance, refresh and service-account signing are external. Fixed www.googleapis.com. Strict request fields, resource IDs, UTF-16/UTF-8; 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline starts before profile/secret resolution, 1 MiB JSON response, 256 KiB binary transfers, 512 KiB request and 100 ms bounded cleanup. Pages 1–100, explicit pageToken continuation. Known provider fields projected to typed resources; unknown fields omitted. Size/version/quota strings preserve integer precision. Files update addParents/removeParents perform explicit moves. Native Workspace files require Export; Download uses alt=media for stored binary files. New byte upload is one multipart request; replacement uses simple media. No resumable sessions, emptyTrash, watchers, automatic ownership transfer or background listeners. Sharing/ownership changes require suitable query and permission fields and must run sequentially per file. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3 https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/files https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-uploads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-downloads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-sharing https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/changes/list https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2

definitions.documentation:
Get Shared Drive: GET /drives/{driveId}. Exactly one request, no retries, redirects or automatic pagination. OAuth bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; optional built-in $connection profile uses RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken, apiKey or password as an already issued bearer token. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. Supply OAuth scopes and provider permissions appropriate to this operation; issuance, refresh and service-account signing are external. Fixed www.googleapis.com. Strict request fields, resource IDs, UTF-16/UTF-8; 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline starts before profile/secret resolution, 1 MiB JSON response, 256 KiB binary transfers, 512 KiB request and 100 ms bounded cleanup. Pages 1–100, explicit pageToken continuation. Known provider fields projected to typed resources; unknown fields omitted. Size/version/quota strings preserve integer precision. Files update addParents/removeParents perform explicit moves. Native Workspace files require Export; Download uses alt=media for stored binary files. New byte upload is one multipart request; replacement uses simple media. No resumable sessions, emptyTrash, watchers, automatic ownership transfer or background listeners. Sharing/ownership changes require suitable query and permission fields and must run sequentially per file. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3 https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/files https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-uploads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-downloads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-sharing https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/changes/list https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2

definitions.name: Create Shared Drive (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Create Shared Drive: POST /drives. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation DRIVES_CREATE. External action may succeed before a timeout; reconcile before repeating. Exactly one request, no retries, redirects or automatic pagination. OAuth bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; optional built-in $connection profile uses RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken, apiKey or password as an already issued bearer token. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. Supply OAuth scopes and provider permissions appropriate to this operation; issuance, refresh and service-account signing are external. Fixed www.googleapis.com. Strict request fields, resource IDs, UTF-16/UTF-8; 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline starts before profile/secret resolution, 1 MiB JSON response, 256 KiB binary transfers, 512 KiB request and 100 ms bounded cleanup. Pages 1–100, explicit pageToken continuation. Known provider fields projected to typed resources; unknown fields omitted. Size/version/quota strings preserve integer precision. Files update addParents/removeParents perform explicit moves. Native Workspace files require Export; Download uses alt=media for stored binary files. New byte upload is one multipart request; replacement uses simple media. No resumable sessions, emptyTrash, watchers, automatic ownership transfer or background listeners. Sharing/ownership changes require suitable query and permission fields and must run sequentially per file. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3 https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/files https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-uploads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-downloads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-sharing https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/changes/list https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2

definitions.name: Update Shared Drive (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Update Shared Drive: PATCH /drives/{driveId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation DRIVES_UPDATE. External action may succeed before a timeout; reconcile before repeating. Exactly one request, no retries, redirects or automatic pagination. OAuth bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; optional built-in $connection profile uses RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken, apiKey or password as an already issued bearer token. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. Supply OAuth scopes and provider permissions appropriate to this operation; issuance, refresh and service-account signing are external. Fixed www.googleapis.com. Strict request fields, resource IDs, UTF-16/UTF-8; 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline starts before profile/secret resolution, 1 MiB JSON response, 256 KiB binary transfers, 512 KiB request and 100 ms bounded cleanup. Pages 1–100, explicit pageToken continuation. Known provider fields projected to typed resources; unknown fields omitted. Size/version/quota strings preserve integer precision. Files update addParents/removeParents perform explicit moves. Native Workspace files require Export; Download uses alt=media for stored binary files. New byte upload is one multipart request; replacement uses simple media. No resumable sessions, emptyTrash, watchers, automatic ownership transfer or background listeners. Sharing/ownership changes require suitable query and permission fields and must run sequentially per file. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3 https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/files https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-uploads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-downloads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-sharing https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/changes/list https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2

definitions.name: Unhide Shared Drive (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Unhide Shared Drive: POST /drives/{driveId}/unhide. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation DRIVES_UNHIDE. External action may succeed before a timeout; reconcile before repeating. Exactly one request, no retries, redirects or automatic pagination. OAuth bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; optional built-in $connection profile uses RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken, apiKey or password as an already issued bearer token. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. Supply OAuth scopes and provider permissions appropriate to this operation; issuance, refresh and service-account signing are external. Fixed www.googleapis.com. Strict request fields, resource IDs, UTF-16/UTF-8; 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline starts before profile/secret resolution, 1 MiB JSON response, 256 KiB binary transfers, 512 KiB request and 100 ms bounded cleanup. Pages 1–100, explicit pageToken continuation. Known provider fields projected to typed resources; unknown fields omitted. Size/version/quota strings preserve integer precision. Files update addParents/removeParents perform explicit moves. Native Workspace files require Export; Download uses alt=media for stored binary files. New byte upload is one multipart request; replacement uses simple media. No resumable sessions, emptyTrash, watchers, automatic ownership transfer or background listeners. Sharing/ownership changes require suitable query and permission fields and must run sequentially per file. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3 https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/files https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-uploads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-downloads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-sharing https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/changes/list https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2

definitions.documentation:
List File Revisions: GET /files/{fileId}/revisions. Exactly one request, no retries, redirects or automatic pagination. OAuth bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; optional built-in $connection profile uses RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken, apiKey or password as an already issued bearer token. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. Supply OAuth scopes and provider permissions appropriate to this operation; issuance, refresh and service-account signing are external. Fixed www.googleapis.com. Strict request fields, resource IDs, UTF-16/UTF-8; 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline starts before profile/secret resolution, 1 MiB JSON response, 256 KiB binary transfers, 512 KiB request and 100 ms bounded cleanup. Pages 1–100, explicit pageToken continuation. Known provider fields projected to typed resources; unknown fields omitted. Size/version/quota strings preserve integer precision. Files update addParents/removeParents perform explicit moves. Native Workspace files require Export; Download uses alt=media for stored binary files. New byte upload is one multipart request; replacement uses simple media. No resumable sessions, emptyTrash, watchers, automatic ownership transfer or background listeners. Sharing/ownership changes require suitable query and permission fields and must run sequentially per file. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3 https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/files https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-uploads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-downloads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-sharing https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/changes/list https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2

Get File Revision: GET /files/{fileId}/revisions/{revisionId}. Exactly one request, no retries, redirects or automatic pagination. OAuth bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; optional built-in $connection profile uses RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken, apiKey or password as an already issued bearer token. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. Supply OAuth scopes and provider permissions appropriate to this operation; issuance, refresh and service-account signing are external. Fixed www.googleapis.com. Strict request fields, resource IDs, UTF-16/UTF-8; 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline starts before profile/secret resolution, 1 MiB JSON response, 256 KiB binary transfers, 512 KiB request and 100 ms bounded cleanup. Pages 1–100, explicit pageToken continuation. Known provider fields projected to typed resources; unknown fields omitted. Size/version/quota strings preserve integer precision. Files update addParents/removeParents perform explicit moves. Native Workspace files require Export; Download uses alt=media for stored binary files. New byte upload is one multipart request; replacement uses simple media. No resumable sessions, emptyTrash, watchers, automatic ownership transfer or background listeners. Sharing/ownership changes require suitable query and permission fields and must run sequentially per file. definitions.name: Delete File Revision (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Delete File Revision: DELETE /files/{fileId}/revisions/{revisionId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation REVISIONS_DELETE. External action may succeed before a timeout; reconcile before repeating. Exactly one request, no retries, redirects or automatic pagination. OAuth bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; optional built-in $connection profile uses RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken, apiKey or password as an already issued bearer token. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. Supply OAuth scopes and provider permissions appropriate to this operation; issuance, refresh and service-account signing are external. Fixed www.googleapis.com. Strict request fields, resource IDs, UTF-16/UTF-8; 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline starts before profile/secret resolution, 1 MiB JSON response, 256 KiB binary transfers, 512 KiB request and 100 ms bounded cleanup. Pages 1–100, explicit pageToken continuation. Known provider fields projected to typed resources; unknown fields omitted. Size/version/quota strings preserve integer precision. Files update addParents/removeParents perform explicit moves. Native Workspace files require Export; Download uses alt=media for stored binary files. New byte upload is one multipart request; replacement uses simple media. No resumable sessions, emptyTrash, watchers, automatic ownership transfer or background listeners. Sharing/ownership changes require suitable query and permission fields and must run sequentially per file. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3 https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/files https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-uploads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-downloads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-sharing https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/changes/list https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2

definitions.name: List File Comments (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
List File Comments: GET /files/{fileId}/comments. Exactly one request, no retries, redirects or automatic pagination. OAuth bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; optional built-in $connection profile uses RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken, apiKey or password as an already issued bearer token. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. Supply OAuth scopes and provider permissions appropriate to this operation; issuance, refresh and service-account signing are external. Fixed www.googleapis.com. Strict request fields, resource IDs, UTF-16/UTF-8; 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline starts before profile/secret resolution, 1 MiB JSON response, 256 KiB binary transfers, 512 KiB request and 100 ms bounded cleanup. Pages 1–100, explicit pageToken continuation. Known provider fields projected to typed resources; unknown fields omitted. Size/version/quota strings preserve integer precision. Files update addParents/removeParents perform explicit moves. Native Workspace files require Export; Download uses alt=media for stored binary files. New byte upload is one multipart request; replacement uses simple media. No resumable sessions, emptyTrash, watchers, automatic ownership transfer or background listeners. Sharing/ownership changes require suitable query and permission fields and must run sequentially per file. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3 https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/files https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-uploads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-downloads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-sharing https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/changes/list https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2

definitions.name: Get File Comment (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Get File Comment: GET /files/{fileId}/comments/{commentId}. Exactly one request, no retries, redirects or automatic pagination. OAuth bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; optional built-in $connection profile uses RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken, apiKey or password as an already issued bearer token. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. Supply OAuth scopes and provider permissions appropriate to this operation; issuance, refresh and service-account signing are external. Fixed www.googleapis.com. Strict request fields, resource IDs, UTF-16/UTF-8; 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline starts before profile/secret resolution, 1 MiB JSON response, 256 KiB binary transfers, 512 KiB request and 100 ms bounded cleanup. Pages 1–100, explicit pageToken continuation. Known provider fields projected to typed resources; unknown fields omitted. Size/version/quota strings preserve integer precision. Files update addParents/removeParents perform explicit moves. Native Workspace files require Export; Download uses alt=media for stored binary files. New byte upload is one multipart request; replacement uses simple media. No resumable sessions, emptyTrash, watchers, automatic ownership transfer or background listeners. Sharing/ownership changes require suitable query and permission fields and must run sequentially per file. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3 https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/files https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-uploads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-downloads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-sharing https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/changes/list https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2

definitions.documentation:
Create File Comment: POST /files/{fileId}/comments. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation COMMENTS_CREATE. External action may succeed before a timeout; reconcile before repeating. Exactly one request, no retries, redirects or automatic pagination. OAuth bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; optional built-in $connection profile uses RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken, apiKey or password as an already issued bearer token. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. Supply OAuth scopes and provider permissions appropriate to this operation; issuance, refresh and service-account signing are external. Fixed www.googleapis.com. Strict request fields, resource IDs, UTF-16/UTF-8; 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline starts before profile/secret resolution, 1 MiB JSON response, 256 KiB binary transfers, 512 KiB request and 100 ms bounded cleanup. Pages 1–100, explicit pageToken continuation. Known provider fields projected to typed resources; unknown fields omitted. Size/version/quota strings preserve integer precision. Files update addParents/removeParents perform explicit moves. Native Workspace files require Export; Download uses alt=media for stored binary files. New byte upload is one multipart request; replacement uses simple media. No resumable sessions, emptyTrash, watchers, automatic ownership transfer or background listeners. Sharing/ownership changes require suitable query and permission fields and must run sequentially per file. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3 https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/files https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-uploads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-downloads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-sharing https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/changes/list https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2

Update File Comment: PATCH /files/{fileId}/comments/{commentId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation COMMENTS_UPDATE. External action may succeed before a timeout; reconcile before repeating. Exactly one request, no retries, redirects or automatic pagination. OAuth bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; optional built-in $connection profile uses RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken, apiKey or password as an already issued bearer token. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. Supply OAuth scopes and provider permissions appropriate to this operation; issuance, refresh and service-account signing are external. Fixed www.googleapis.com. Strict request fields, resource IDs, UTF-16/UTF-8; 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline starts before profile/secret resolution, 1 MiB JSON response, 256 KiB binary transfers, 512 KiB request and 100 ms bounded cleanup. Pages 1–100, explicit pageToken continuation. Known provider fields projected to typed resources; unknown fields omitted. Size/version/quota strings preserve integer precision. Files update addParents/removeParents perform explicit moves. Native Workspace files require Export; Download uses alt=media for stored binary files. New byte upload is one multipart request; replacement uses simple media. No resumable sessions, emptyTrash, watchers, automatic ownership transfer or background listeners. Sharing/ownership changes require suitable query and permission fields and must run sequentially per file. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3 https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/files https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-uploads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-downloads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-sharing https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/changes/list https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2

Delete File Comment: DELETE /files/{fileId}/comments/{commentId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation COMMENTS_DELETE. External action may succeed before a timeout; reconcile before repeating. Exactly one request, no retries, redirects or automatic pagination. OAuth bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; optional built-in $connection profile uses RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken, apiKey or password as an already issued bearer token. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. Supply OAuth scopes and provider permissions appropriate to this operation; issuance, refresh and service-account signing are external. Fixed www.googleapis.com. Strict request fields, resource IDs, UTF-16/UTF-8; 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline starts before profile/secret resolution, 1 MiB JSON response, 256 KiB binary transfers, 512 KiB request and 100 ms bounded cleanup. Pages 1–100, explicit pageToken continuation. Known provider fields projected to typed resources; unknown fields omitted. Size/version/quota strings preserve integer precision. Files update addParents/removeParents perform explicit moves. Native Workspace files require Export; Download uses alt=media for stored binary files. New byte upload is one multipart request; replacement uses simple media. No resumable sessions, emptyTrash, watchers, automatic ownership transfer or background listeners. Sharing/ownership changes require suitable query and permission fields and must run sequentially per file. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3 https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/files https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-uploads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-downloads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-sharing https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/changes/list https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2

definitions.name: Get Comment Reply (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Get Comment Reply: GET /files/{fileId}/comments/{commentId}/replies/{replyId}. Exactly one request, no retries, redirects or automatic pagination. OAuth bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; optional built-in $connection profile uses RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken, apiKey or password as an already issued bearer token. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. Supply OAuth scopes and provider permissions appropriate to this operation; issuance, refresh and service-account signing are external. Fixed www.googleapis.com. Strict request fields, resource IDs, UTF-16/UTF-8; 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline starts before profile/secret resolution, 1 MiB JSON response, 256 KiB binary transfers, 512 KiB request and 100 ms bounded cleanup. Pages 1–100, explicit pageToken continuation. Known provider fields projected to typed resources; unknown fields omitted. Size/version/quota strings preserve integer precision. Files update addParents/removeParents perform explicit moves. Native Workspace files require Export; Download uses alt=media for stored binary files. New byte upload is one multipart request; replacement uses simple media. No resumable sessions, emptyTrash, watchers, automatic ownership transfer or background listeners. Sharing/ownership changes require suitable query and permission fields and must run sequentially per file. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3 https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/files https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-uploads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-downloads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-sharing https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/changes/list https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2

definitions.name: Create Comment Reply (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Create Comment Reply: POST /files/{fileId}/comments/{commentId}/replies. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation REPLIES_CREATE. External action may succeed before a timeout; reconcile before repeating. Exactly one request, no retries, redirects or automatic pagination. OAuth bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; optional built-in $connection profile uses RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken, apiKey or password as an already issued bearer token. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. Supply OAuth scopes and provider permissions appropriate to this operation; issuance, refresh and service-account signing are external. Fixed www.googleapis.com. Strict request fields, resource IDs, UTF-16/UTF-8; 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline starts before profile/secret resolution, 1 MiB JSON response, 256 KiB binary transfers, 512 KiB request and 100 ms bounded cleanup. Pages 1–100, explicit pageToken continuation. Known provider fields projected to typed resources; unknown fields omitted. Size/version/quota strings preserve integer precision. Files update addParents/removeParents perform explicit moves. Native Workspace files require Export; Download uses alt=media for stored binary files. New byte upload is one multipart request; replacement uses simple media. No resumable sessions, emptyTrash, watchers, automatic ownership transfer or background listeners. Sharing/ownership changes require suitable query and permission fields and must run sequentially per file. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3 https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/files https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-uploads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-downloads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-sharing https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/changes/list https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2

definitions.name: Update Comment Reply (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Update Comment Reply: PATCH /files/{fileId}/comments/{commentId}/replies/{replyId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation REPLIES_UPDATE. External action may succeed before a timeout; reconcile before repeating. Exactly one request, no retries, redirects or automatic pagination. OAuth bearer token from encrypted GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret; optional built-in $connection profile uses RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken, apiKey or password as an already issued bearer token. Explicit tokenSecret overrides profile credentials. Supply OAuth scopes and provider permissions appropriate to this operation; issuance, refresh and service-account signing are external. Fixed www.googleapis.com. Strict request fields, resource IDs, UTF-16/UTF-8; 10 s default/30 s maximum total deadline starts before profile/secret resolution, 1 MiB JSON response, 256 KiB binary transfers, 512 KiB request and 100 ms bounded cleanup. Pages 1–100, explicit pageToken continuation. Known provider fields projected to typed resources; unknown fields omitted. Size/version/quota strings preserve integer precision. Files update addParents/removeParents perform explicit moves. Native Workspace files require Export; Download uses alt=media for stored binary files. New byte upload is one multipart request; replacement uses simple media. No resumable sessions, emptyTrash, watchers, automatic ownership transfer or background listeners. Sharing/ownership changes require suitable query and permission fields and must run sequentially per file. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3 https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/files https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-uploads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-downloads https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-sharing https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/changes/list https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2
